coordinate_system.pixel_center_convention: Integer x/y values are raster pixel sample centers. Polygon boundaries are half-pixel isolines of the exact raster.

mask.hit_rule: Map the pointer through the exact displayed artwork rectangle into this 1448x1086 source canvas, then sample the native integer mask pixel. Use nearest-neighbor sampling only; RGB values are IDs, not visual colors.

binding_contract.hardware_binding_id: Unset deliberately. Map region_key to the existing application bindings.
binding_contract.main_wheel: One physical wheel region including its center. Press/up/down are existing application actions, not extra painted button regions.
binding_contract.sideplate_filter: Use sideplate_buttons to apply the existing selected-plate interaction policy.

validation.boundaries: Conservative button-face interiors traced against the supplied artwork. Outer decorative glow is excluded. Wheel grooves form one filled region.

regions.label: Wheel surface (press and scroll action group)
